title: fix(ui): quote multiword Usage filter values when selecting them
body:
Fixes #184580

## What Problem This Solves

In Control UI Usage, selecting a filter value that contains a space (for example the model `Local Model`) from the Model, Provider, Agent, Channel or Tool menus writes `model:Local Model` into the query. The query parser splits on whitespace outside double quotes, so this becomes the term `model:Local` plus a free-text term `Model`. The menu option stays unchecked and the matching session and its usage disappear.

## User Impact

Selecting a multiword value now writes `model:"Local Model"`. The option stays checked and the matching sessions and totals remain visible, as they already did when the user typed the quotes by hand. Single-word values are written exactly as before.

## Why This Change Was Made

The parser already supports quoted multiword values (`extractQueryTerms`), so the fix is at the serialization boundary in `ui/src/pages/usage/query.ts`:

- New `formatQueryToken(key, value)` quotes a value when it contains whitespace.
- `setQueryTokensForKey` (menu selections) uses it for newly added values. Retained terms keep their authored spelling, as before.
- `buildQuerySuggestions` uses it for the inserted suggestion value; the visible label is unchanged.

Accepted edge case: a value containing a literal `"` still cannot be expressed, because the query grammar has no escape for it. This PR does not change that.

## Evidence

### Tests

`ui/src/pages/usage/query.test.ts` has a new case, "quotes newly selected multiword values so they parse as one term":

- It selects `Local Model` and expects `provider:local model:"Local Model" `, parsed back into the single term `{ key: "model", value: "Local Model" }`.
- Reselecting keeps the same query with no duplicate term.
- The suggestion for `model:Loc` inserts `model:"Local Model"`.

It fails on main, which writes `model:Local Model`, and passes on this branch. The file passes 10/10.

`ui/src/e2e/usage-overview.e2e.test.ts` has a new browser case, "keeps a multiword model selected and filtered after choosing it from the menu". It uses the existing `installUsageOverviewGateway` fixture, which projects `sessions.usage` through the real `buildUsageOverview`. It selects **Local Model** from the Model menu and expects the option checked, the query `model:"Local Model" `, the one matching session, and `100 Tokens / $0.01 Cost / 1 Sessions`. On this Windows machine the UI e2e harness stalls before any test runs (same on main, with Playwright Chromium 1248 and with Edge), so this case is typechecked and linted locally and runs in PR CI. The live run below exercises the same flow by hand.

In the whole `ui/src/pages/usage` directory, 9 browser tests (calendar selection, overview cost windows, two `renderUsage` cases) fail identically on main on this Windows machine and are untouched by this change.

Checks run locally: oxfmt, oxlint, `git diff --check`, `pnpm tsgo:ui` and `pnpm tsgo:test:ui` are clean.

### Live run (Windows 11, Chromium)

This is the real Control UI (`scripts/control-ui-mock-dev.ts`, Vite dev build) opened in Chromium. For this run only, the mock's `sessions.usage` responses were computed by the real `buildUsageOverview` over two synthetic rows; that local change is not part of this PR:

- "Synthetic usage example": model `Local Model`, 100 tokens, $0.01.
- "Hosted model session": model `gpt-5-mini`, 300 tokens, $0.03.

The flow is Usage → **Model** menu → **Local Model**. Only `ui/src/pages/usage/query.ts` differs between the two runs.

![live run](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wr-web/openclaw/proof-assets/184580/proof-184580.png)

| | main | this branch |
|---|---|---|
| query written by the menu | **`model:Local Model `**, parsed as `model:Local` + free text `Model` | **`model:"Local Model" `** |
| "Local Model" option `aria-checked` | **false** | **true** |
| matching sessions | **0 of 2** | **1 of 2** ("Synthetic usage example") |
| tokens / cost / sessions | 0 / $0.00 / 0 | 100 / $0.01 / 1 |


### Real recorded usage: Linux built-Gateway proof

[Inspected before/after screenshots and actual usage observations](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184707#issuecomment-6425195547) on unchanged head `30f6e5a67cf3ff009fd5cd967102d8cd81400b7d` versus main `cfb41dddac89dcf40325273b98ffb1c7a9d209a2`, twice each. Compiled agent commands generated real persisted usage through isolated built Gateways against a deterministic external loopback HTTP model fixture. Wire requests preserve the configured multiword model ID `Local Model`; sessions.usage reports the actual sessions/totals. No synthetic Gateway usage responses or DB seeding.

```text
Main 2/2: model:Local Model → unchecked, no rows, 0 tokens / 0 sessions.
Candidate 2/2: model:"Local Model" → checked, Usage multiword session, 144 tokens / 1 session.
Manual quoted control, both revisions: correct row, 144 tokens / 1 session.
Single-word selection control, both revisions: correct row, 144 tokens / 1 session.
```

Full main build encountered an unrelated native-declaration Promise.withResolvers library-target failure; supported runtime-only build mode then freshly compiled production JavaScript and full Control UI successfully. No product code changed for the proof and no push was required.
